name: Undertow-Haven

civilization.name: Vessari Concord
civilization.notes: Amphibious civilization of raft-city builders who ride the planetary hurricane belt, harvesting storm energy and trading across the great ocean.

description: Undertow-Haven is an ocean without shores, a single world-sea girdled by the Maelstrom Crown, a planet-spanning hurricane that has raged for as long as records exist. Outside the Crown's band, the water runs warm and glassy over drowned continents, marked only by tectonic rifts that glow faintly through the shallows. The dense, humid sky stacks itself into thunderheads visible for hundreds of kilometers.

The air tastes of rain before it falls and never quite dries on the skin; sound carries strangely, with storm-roar arriving minutes after the lightning. Nights pulse with continuous heat lightning inside the Crown, a silent aurora of white and green. For the Vessari, who live half their lives in the water, the planet's moods are read the way land-dwellers read faces.

The Vessari Concord grew from nomadic raft-clans into a spacefaring power by harvesting the Crown's fury—storm-anchors drinking lightning, kites the size of districts hauling floating cities along the hurricane's calm eye-wall. Their raft-cities welcome offworld traders at the edge of the storm band, though Vessari law forbids outsiders from entering the Crown itself. No treaty text explains why.

Helium-3 skimming rights have made Undertow-Haven a prize in every trade negotiation for a generation, and corporate surveyors keep probing the hurricane's heart with drones that never come back. Last year, one of the ancient beacons at the system's edge switched from a maintenance chirp to a full distress call—in Vessari, in a dialect dead for four hundred years. The Concord has stopped issuing storm-season forecasts, and their kite-fleets are arming.
